campaignScope: Ghatana Media PDP-0 Product Truth; Recorder/Studio successor and declarative production acceptance cases
reviewKind: read-only semantic observation; no canonical sources edited

findings.whatIsWrong: These 49 cases use only the shared precondition 'A declared source and authorized Media project revision are in scope.' The declarative-production profile defines a source owner but no shared participant-actor binding or actor applicability rule. Consequently the cases do not identify whose product outcome is being served or distinguish the participant actor from the authority that admits a Media effect. This leaves an ambiguity in product-truth intent across animation, simulation, and unified production cases; it is not a request to add authorization mechanics to each case.
findings.predecessor: PDP-0 canonical actor and responsibility definitions (requirements.yaml actorReferenceAuthority; actors-responsibilities.yaml); resolve their applicability for the declarativeProductionProfile before refining the cases.
findings.acceptanceCriteria: For each affected case, identify or normatively inherit the intended participant actor/outcome from a source-grounded canonical actor and state that participant identity does not itself grant effect authority; name the relevant product/consumer authority owner where that boundary changes meaning. Preserve stable case IDs, existing requirement/capability/surface traces, and keep detailed authorization checks out of the case if they belong to platform/PDP-1 contracts. A validator should reject an unbound case/profile while accepting an explicit shared profile-level actor rule.
findings.nextAction: Reconcile actor/outcome meaning at PDP-0, then refresh only dependent profile projections and re-run the PDP-0 definition validation. No owner approval or phase completion is asserted.

coverageNotes.recorder84: All 84 clauses have stable IDs, given/when/then/rejection, canonical parent requirement, capability leaf and owner surface. Feature profiles reference all 84 exactly once; the definition checker additionally verifies actor bindings at feature-profile level, exact surface/capability group ownership and denominator preservation. Reviewed as BOUND_EXISTING for PDP-0 in this bounded subtask.
coverageNotes.declarative61: All 61 clauses have stable IDs, given/when/then/rejection, parent requirement, capability leaf and surface. Twelve TutorPutor-specific clauses (MEDIA-DECL-P0-AC-040..051) explicitly identify an authorized TutorPutor consumer and the public AEF contract; the remaining 49 are the finding above.
coverageNotes.authorityAndReadback: Across the cases, explicit rejection semantics cover unsupported/unavailable/unknown or denied states in the areas reviewed; Recorder business outcome readback is explicit in MEDIA-REC-P0-AC-013 and MEDIA-REC-P0-AC-045. The declarative cases make source/model/origin and product-versus-science authority boundaries explicit in relevant cases (notably AC-034..039, AC-041..051, AC-053, AC-056, AC-059, AC-061). No independent owner acceptance is evidenced.
coverageNotes.phaseBoundaries: Typed schema/solver/RNG/time representation detail belongs to PDP-1; UI/API/CLI interaction parity belongs to PDP-2; end-to-end journeys and surface completion belong to PDP-3. Findings discovered in these lanes were not included as PDP-0 tasks.
